name: 22821 · Dayton, VA
findings: ZIP 22821 (Dayton) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 7 of them (58%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 7 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22821 (Dayton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 22821 (Dayton) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.7 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 17% of all organizations here have no identified type.
